changes.name: WaterfallCoinSystem100M
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local folder=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap"):WaitForChild("WaterfallIsles"):WaitForChild("WaterfallCoins")
local busy={}
for i=1,8 do
 local coin=folder:WaitForChild("WaterCoin"..i)
 coin.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
  local p=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
  if not p or busy[coin] then return end
  local st=p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
  local c=st and st:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins")
  if not c then return end
  busy[coin]=true
  c.Value+=100000000
  coin.Transparency=1
  coin.CanTouch=false
  local l=coin:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight")
  if l then l.Enabled=false end
  task.delay(10,function()
   if coin.Parent then
    coin.Transparency=0
    coin.CanTouch=true
    if l then l.Enabled=true end
    busy[coin]=nil
   end
  end)
 end)
end
